name: csc-workspace
description: Separate React Native frontend and NestJS backend; no shared dependencies

scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix frontend && npm ci --prefix backendCSC && npm ci --prefix admin-dashboard
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix backendCSC run typecheck && npm --prefix admin-dashboard run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend run test:ci && npm --prefix backendCSC test
